description: This script manipulates NSLU2 firmware images, including reading, writing, and partition management. It contains functions for padding, parsing partition tables, layout, and firmware image processing, as well as command-line options for packing and unpacking firmware images.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads input data to a specified total length with 0xFF bytes.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of block size greater than or equal to given length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of blocks needed to hold given data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary partition entry with name, address, size, and optional skip regions.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a binary partition entry into name, offset, size, and skip regions.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Finds the partition table within firmware data if present.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses a partition table into an array of partition info.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes data to a specified filename.

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints contents of the RedBoot trailer.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the Loader partition and adjusts Kernel and Ramdisk offsets.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Populates partition info based on firmware's partition table.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Verifies and assigns start/size for partitions, ensuring they fit in flash.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Builds binary partition table data from partition info.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Assembles and writes the complete firmware image from partitions.
